grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, corn, spring onions, eggs, cheddar and chives are all plain kitchen and garden foods.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including fresh corn cobs in late August, is an everyday supermarket buy.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a lidded frying pan, bowl, whisk and grater, and a hob-only frittata is beginner-friendly.

works.reason: 500g potatoes with 8 eggs makes a sensible frittata for four, and 12 minutes covered for thin slices then 10 minutes gently to set are realistic.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes covers slicing the potatoes, stripping two cobs and whisking, and the cook steps add up to about 24 minutes.

honest_ingredients.reason: 'Corn cobs' is fresh sweetcorn, and every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the chives, is used in the steps.

seasonal_feel.reason: New-season potatoes and fresh sweetcorn suit late August, and the potatoes form the body of the frittata.

plain_voice.reason: Short, clear British English steps with no restaurant language.

hearty_healthy.reason: Eggs, potatoes, corn and cheese make a filling, wholesome breakfast a family would cook again.
